title: Spectrogram
description: A line of words hidden in sound: a bank of sine tones plays each letter so its spectrogram, scrolling right to left in a monochrome waterfall, spells the line. Type and your words are synthesised and drawn the same way.
intent: Aphex Twin style hidden-image audio as a typing toy: text is rasterised into 64 log-spaced sine partials, played by an AudioWorklet, and the waterfall is read back from a real AnalyserNode with a log frequency axis, so what you see is literally what you hear.
